chunks: Are you so unafraid that He who is in Heaven will not open up the earth to swallow you, when it will begin to tremble?

key_terms.مَن فِي السَّمَاءِ: He who is in the Heaven (referring to God)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the earth 'trembles' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Tawhid al-Af'al* (Oneness of Divine Action), illustrating how God's sovereignty extends from the heavens to the very foundation of the earth. The 'trembling' (*tamur*) is interpreted not merely as a physical phenomenon but as a spiritual reminder of the transient nature of worldly stability in the face of Divine authority. This serves as a precursor to the Day of Judgment, where the earth will be fully unmade and remade, reinforcing the believer's reliance on God alone.
